headline: Türkiye Unemployment Rate Edges Up to 8.4% in September
summary: Türkiye's unemployment rate rose 0.5 percentage points to 8.4% in September, according to official data released on Tuesday.
why: Turkish policymakers are executing a sustained monetary tightening campaign, making labor market indicators critical to gauging macroeconomic cooling.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: An uptick in joblessness reflects cooling domestic demand amid high borrowing costs.
